newsitem.title: LATVIA: STOCKS MIXED, UNIBANKA FALLS FURTHER.
newsitem.headline: STOCKS MIXED, UNIBANKA FALLS FURTHER.

text.p: Latvian stocks were mixed amid lively trade on Wednesday and Unibanka fell for the second consecutive day following the news of the cancellation of merger plans with Zemes Bank, dealers said.
Total turnover was 231,000 lats versus 208,000 lats and Rietumu Bank's bourse index Rietumu advanced 0.41 percent to 229.26.
Market leader Unibanka fell further to 4.80 lats from 4.84 lats on volume of 86,100 lats, with the demand side dominating.
On the secondary list, Daugavpils Chain factory turned over 42,200 lats as it slipped five santimes to 2.80 lats.

Elsewhere on the official list, the Riga Transport Fleet traded 41,100 lats of shares as it edged up a whisker to 1.73 lats from 1.72 lats. Staburadze confectionery added one santime to 1.73 on a small volume of 5,800 lats.
Lode Brick maker on the secondary list was also actively traded as it saw 27,900 shares change hands. It kept gaining ground on good 1996 results and jumped another 10 santimes to 2.86 lats.
Valmiera Glassfibre also advanced slightly, adding three santimes to 2.00 lats. It traded 13,400 lats.
Other shares were traded mostly in volumes not exceeding 1,000 lats, except for fish cannery Kaija with 3,800 lats of shares traded. Kaija added one santime to 2.36 lats.
